rules: A user's explicitly selected work on 12 October remains an editorial decision, not a five-star rating.
Older selected work missing from review galleries is surfaced beside five-star approved paintings in a distinct protected tier, never erased or silently downgraded.
Unverified image matching artist or title is a lead, not a certified correct image. Do not use search thumbnails of another artist's painting.
A selected artwork may await a clean legal high-resolution master; this does not erase its editorial status.
No mutation of earlier curator rating or published art selection. Preserve all 101, including future categories.
